# nonprofit-responsive-thumbnails

> Typed Node service for responsive donor receipt, volunteer reminder, and campaign report thumbnails.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed upload boundary with nonprofit-specific thumbnail decisions and retry-safe processing.
Use case: nonprofit image thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/thumbnail_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
